articles.title: Bitwise calls HYPE ‘most mispriced’ crypto despite 77% rise this year
articles.snippet: Bitwise’s Matt Hougan says Hyperliquid’s token is not priced as if it is tied to a “global super-app,” arguing the platform is more than just a crypto platform.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Markets Flip Green Overnight Ahead of NVDA Earnings
articles.snippet: Crypto majors and stocks are back in the green, while Polymarket just opened private company prediction markets to retail.

articles.title: Bitcoin Faces Greater Quantum Computing Risk Than Ethereum, Citi Warns
articles.snippet: Both Bitcoin and Ethereum face a quantum computing threat, but Citi says the gap between them comes down to governance, not just technology.
